accent.purpose: One italic word in a headline.

label.purpose: Section names, readouts and table headers.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every entrance and hover. No overshoot.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a view.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; padding: 15px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--steel, #262b30); color: var(--bone, #ede7da); font: 500 0.9375rem "Bricolage Grotesque", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; transition: color 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--bone, #ede7da); transform: translateY(101%); transition: transform 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { color: var(--ink, #0b0c0d); border-color: var(--bone, #ede7da); } .ds-btn:hover::before { transform: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--oxide, #ff5b1f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn--primary { background: var(--oxide, #ff5b1f); border-color: var(--oxide, #ff5b1f); color: var(--ink, #0b0c0d); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-ghost { display: inline-flex; padding: 15px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--steel, #262b30); color: var(--bone, #ede7da); font: 500 0.9375rem "Bricolage Grotesque", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms, color 180ms; } .ds-ghost:hover { background: var(--bone, #ede7da); color: var(--ink, #0b0c0d); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--oxide, #ff5b1f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Control Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 0.72rem "JetBrains Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fog, #b4b0a6); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--steel, #262b30); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms, border-color 180ms; } .ds-pill:hover { color: var(--bone, #ede7da); border-color: var(--slate, #7b838b); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--oxide, #ff5b1f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Shape Picker
components.description: Segmented control for the hero solid.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--steel, #262b30); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-seg__b { font: 500 0.72rem "JetBrains Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fog, #b4b0a6); background: none; border: 0; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms, color 180ms; } .ds-seg__b:hover { color: var(--bone, #ede7da); } .ds-seg__b.is-on { background: var(--bone, #ede7da); color: var(--ink, #0b0c0d); } .ds-seg__b:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--oxide, #ff5b1f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Linked or static panel with a wireframe mark.
components.html:
Explicit · B-rep

Boundary Representation

Exact topology, out in the open.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 30px; background: var(--graphite, #131619); border: 1px solid var(--steel, #262b30); border-radius: 18px; transition: border-color 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--slate, #7b838b); } .ds-card__tag { margin: 0 0 40px; font: 500 0.72rem "JetBrains Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--oxide, #ff5b1f); } .ds-card__title { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 560 2rem "Bricolage Grotesque", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; color: var(--bone, #ede7da); } .ds-card__text { margin: 0; color: var(--fog, #b4b0a6); }

components.name: Code Window
components.description: Rust excerpt copied from the repository.
components.css: .ds-win { margin: 0; background: var(--graphite, #131619); border: 1px solid var(--steel, #262b30); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-win__bar { padding: 13px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--steel, #262b30); font: 500 0.75rem "JetBrains Mono", monospace; color: var(--slate, #7b838b); } .ds-win__code { margin: 0; padding: 22px 24px 26px; font: 400 0.844rem/1.72 "JetBrains Mono", monospace; color: var(--fog, #b4b0a6); white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Uppercase mono link with a growing underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { font: 500 0.75rem "JetBrains Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: var(--fog, #b4b0a6); background: linear-gradient(var(--oxide, #ff5b1f), var(--oxide, #ff5b1f)) 0 100% / 0 1px no-repeat; padding-bottom: 3px; transition: background-size 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 180ms; } .ds-nav:hover { background-size: 100% 1px; color: var(--bone, #ede7da); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--oxide, #ff5b1f); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A part sits on a dark bench under one hot light, and everything around it is measured. The wireframe solids are that part. The labels, readouts and drawing marks are the instruments. Orange is the light: it lands on the single thing that matters in a view and nowhere else.

The page is dense with real material. It shows Rust from the repository, a real CLI drawing, committed benchmark data and a real build transcript, and it trusts a technical reader to look. The tone is a machined surface, hard-edged and exact, with one italic word as the only soft thing in a headline. Motion follows the token comment, "premium, rigid metal": fast out, no overshoot, nothing bouncing.

This name and the language around it were inferred from the shipped site. The owner has not chosen them.
keyCharacteristics: One dark theme. There is no light mode.
One accent color on near-neutral surfaces.
Three typefaces, each with one job.
Drawing marks as ornament: corner ticks, hairlines, a faint 96px grid.
Everything readable and reachable before any JavaScript runs.

rules.name: The One Hot Light Rule
rules.body: Oxide marks a single focal point per view. A second orange element in the same view should be a reason to remove one.

rules.name: The Check Both Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Any new secondary text color must clear 4.5:1 on Graphite as well as on Ink. Slate once passed on Ink alone and failed on every panel.

rules.name: The One Italic Word Rule
rules.body: A headline gets at most one Instrument Serif Italic word, and that word carries the idea. Never set a whole line in it.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Source Rule
rules.body: Write labels in sentence case and let CSS uppercase them. Hard-coded capitals read badly in screen readers and in copied text.

rules.name: The Mono Means Measured Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for code, data, readouts and labels. It is not a costume for prose.

rules.name: The Grow, Don't Clip Rule
rules.body: Copy stays in normal flow. Absolute positioning is for decoration only.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest on the bench. A panel earns separation with a tone step and a hairline, never a shadow.

dos: Do read every color from `brand/tokens.css`. The canvas uses the same tokens.
Do animate opacity and transform only, using `--ease-out` or GSAP's `expo.out`.
Do keep copy in normal flow, so it can grow under zoom, text spacing and small screens.
Do put a pause control beside anything that moves on its own.
Do pad SplitText line masks, so descenders and italic overhang stay inside the clip.
Do link a claim to the evidence for it.
donts: Don't use `visibility` or `autoAlpha` for reveals. They remove content from the tab order and the accessibility tree.
Don't run SplitText over an element containing a link. It strips the link's accessible name and breaks its underline.
Don't hide text that has already painted in order to animate it in.
Don't add shadows, fake window controls, pulsing status dots or marquees. They were removed on purpose.

Don't add a kicker to a new heading that already names its section. The nine existing section labels stay because those headings are slogans and the labels say what each section is. This is a known exception and the design detector still reports it.
